body.sub: How Plants Survive in the Sahara
lines: The peyote cactus has a thick stem.
It stores a lot of water.
It has no leaves or branches.
The olive tree has shallow roots.
They get water fast when it rains.
It has small and narrow leaves.
The tamarisk shrub has deep roots.
ko: 페요테 선인장은 두꺼운 줄기를 가지고 있다.
올리브 나무는 얕은 뿌리를 가지고 있다.
그것들은 비가 오면 물을 빨리 얻는다.
그것은 작고 좁은 잎을 가지고 있다.
타마리스크 관목은 깊은 뿌리를 가지고 있다.
body.text: The peyote cactus has a thick stem. It stores a lot of water. It has no leaves or branches. It doesn't lose much water. The olive tree has shallow roots. They get water fast when it rains. It has small and narrow leaves. They don't lose much water. The tamarisk shrub has deep roots. They take in underground water. It has thin branches. It survives with little water.
